::: {#exm-hers-odds-ratio-reversible}

#### Reversing the roles of treatment and exercise in HERS

In @exm-hers-odds-ratio-cross-product, the [odds ratio](#def-odds-ratio) compares the [odds](https://morrison-lab.github.io/pds/probability-basics.html#def-odds) of regular exercise between the hormone therapy and placebo groups.
Reversing the roles compares the odds of hormone therapy between the women who exercise regularly and those who do not:

```{r}
#| label: hers-or-reversed
#| code-fold: false
counts <- table(HT = hers$HT, exercise = hers$exercise)
odds_ht_exercise <- counts["hormone therapy", "yes"] / counts["placebo", "yes"]
odds_ht_no_exercise <- counts["hormone therapy", "no"] / counts["placebo", "no"]
or_reversed <- odds_ht_exercise / odds_ht_no_exercise
or_reversed
```

The reversed odds ratio is `r round(or_reversed, 3)`.
It equals the odds ratio `r round(or_hat, 3)` of @exm-hers-odds-ratio, as @thm-odds-ratio-reversible states.
:::
